description: List all images, audio, and video files referenced in a Wikipedia article, with source URLs and gallery/lead-image flags. Select the language edition with lang (default en). Data: Wikipedia REST API (wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/media-list), no auth required.

lang.description: Wikipedia language edition subdomain code (default en, e.g. de, fr, ja, zh-yue)

title.description: Article title, spaces or underscores accepted (e.g. Albert_Einstein)

name: wikimedia-rest.pages.media_list

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Wikipedia Page Media List
